    Interface CleanOptions

    Options for Emap.cleanLayer. Heavy topology-repair pass — O(N²) on polygon counts in the worst case — so opt in via explicit invocation. Every field is optional; omitting them lets mapshaper apply its built-in defaults.

    Example

    Runnable example association: buffer, check-geometry, clip-erase.

    interface CleanOptions {
        allowEmpty?: boolean;
        allowOverlaps?: boolean;
        gapFillArea?: number;
        noArcDissolve?: boolean;
        noSnap?: boolean;
        onlyArcs?: boolean;
        overlapRule?: "min-id" | "max-id" | "min-area" | "max-area";
        rewind?: boolean;
        sliverControl?: number;
        snapInterval?: number;
        source: string;
        target: string;
    }

    allowOverlaps?: boolean

    OptionalgapFillArea

    gapFillArea?: number

    Maximum area (in source-CRS units²) of gaps to fill in. Gaps larger than this are kept as holes. Maps to mapshaper's gap-fill-area=N.
